title: Annotatio II §.VI open: SUBTILIOR first author — not Berengar but Ascelinus (Cave vs Bayer/Guitmund)
pass_a_gloss: §. VI. The first Author of the LATTER or SUBTLER CONSUBSTANTIATION is not Berengar — held so by Guitmund from mere uncertainty and another’s report, whom Bayer followed as a blind guide (Disputation on Impanation nos. 15–16); but ASCELINUS, a certain MONK, remembered by William Cave, yet unknown to many, as also to Bayer.
pass_b_english: §.VI: first author of the subtler Consubstantiation is not Berengar — Guitmund guessed that from hearsay, and Bayer followed him blind.
It is Ascelinus, a monk Cave remembers and Bayer (with many) never knew.
source_text: §. VI. POSTERIORIS seu SUBTILIORIS CONSUBSTANTIATIONIS Autor primus non Berengarius est, ex mera incertitudine & aliena relatione, à Guitmundo habitus, quem cæcum ducem secutus est Bajerus Disput. de Impan. num. 15. 16; Sed ASCELINUS, MONACHUS quidam, Wilhelmo Caveo memoratus, multis verò, ut & Bajero ignoratus.
